headline: Bokey Grant creates "low-tech" sanctuary in Australian Flame Zone
context: Architecture studio Bokey Grant has designed a monolithic house on the edge of a bushland escarpment in New South Wales, Australia. Named EA House (Esther and Albert's), the 170-square-metre family home is located on the land of the Gundungurra people in the Southern Highlands. "
